sampling_strategy.rationale: NO SAMPLING WAS PERFORMED, AND THE NUMBERS IN THIS OBJECT ARE SCHEMA FLOORS, NOT MEASUREMENTS. The whole tree holds exactly one raster file (images/build_output.png, 31,254 bytes — a README build screenshot) and zero document images, so there is nothing to sample. This schema requires `sample_size` >= 100 and `confidence_level` >= 0.8, and the fields are mandatory, so the minimum permitted values are emitted to satisfy the contract: sample_size 100 and confidence_level 0.8 describe no sample that was ever drawn. `method: pure-random` is likewise a forced selection from a closed enum, not a chosen methodology. Do not read any value in this object as evidence. The only measured figures in this document are scale_estimate.image_count_estimate (1 — an exact file count, not an estimate) and its two size fields, derived from `ls -l images/`.

risk_findings.finding: THIS ARTIFACT IS A SCHEMA-REQUIRED NULL RESULT AND MUST NOT BE CONSUMED AS AN ASSESSMENT. The tiff-corpus-assessor step was dispatched against an application with no image corpus (zero *.tif/*.tiff files; the single raster is images/build_output.png, a build screenshot). The schema floors several required numeric fields above zero — image_count_estimate >= 1, sample_size >= 100, confidence_level >= 0.8, overall_score >= 1, factors minItems 1, waves minItems 1 — and forces a choice from closed enums for store_type, access_method, sampling method, recommended_engine, inference_strategy and prioritization_basis. Every such value here is the minimum or an arbitrary forced selection, flagged in the adjacent free-text field. In particular `recommended_engine: tesseract` is a schema-forced enum pick, NOT an engine recommendation.
risk_findings.mitigation: Treat corpus assessment as not-applicable for application d634afdb-97cc-4589-a080-5766d4f377d5 and exclude this document from any imaging roadmap, cost roll-up or OCR-capacity plan. Downstream consumers should key on source_system.system_name ('None — ... no image corpus') and on the zeroed cost_projection rather than on the floored numerics. Separately, the pipeline configuration should be corrected so the tiff-corpus-assessor is not dispatched for applications whose catalog entry records no imaging surface; and the schema should gain an explicit not-applicable representation so a null result need not be encoded as a floor value.

risk_findings.finding: Absence of an imaging surface is corroborated, not merely unobserved: the catalog entry for this application records no image store, the application has no file I/O whatsoever (its only state is an in-memory IList<Item> at src/GildedRose.Console/Program.cs:7, seeded from hardcoded literals at Program.cs:16-26), and its sole output is the literal string "OMGHAI!" at Program.cs:10. There is no Unisys InfoImage, Documentum, FileNet or SharePoint reference anywhere in the 22 git-tracked files.
